feedback_text: For a dental claim, does the dentist's treatment chart need to accompany the itemized bill, or is the bill enough?
The checklist requires an employer declaration, but I am self-employed and there is no alternative listed. I cannot move past this step.
Please add examples beside each evidence category for claims involving home nursing care.
I scanned a five-page specialist report as one PDF, but after upload the attachment list contains only the first page.
The portal accepted my records after I divided one large file into three smaller files. It took extra time, but I completed the submission.
A drag-and-drop area would make it easier to attach several receipts from a laptop.
The occupation question offers employed or unemployed, but neither describes parental leave. Which option should I select?
Changing the incident category erased three sections I had completed, so I had to enter the details again.
I submitted the claim from my phone in under five minutes, and the final review made every answer easy to check.
The tracker says external review. Does that mean the clinic is reviewing the claim or your claims team?
My claim moved from awaiting decision back to received, with no explanation, after I had already waited two weeks.
Weekly email updates would be useful while a claim is being assessed.
The payment statement groups two appointments under one total. Please show a separate amount for each visit.
The reimbursement went to an account I had already replaced in my profile, and the bank has now returned the transfer.
The reimbursement arrived on schedule. The bank description was cryptic, but I could match it to my claim using the amount.
The verification link for my new email says it was already used, even when I open the first message for the first time.
I could not sign in on my tablet, but the phone app worked, so I used it to submit the claim.
Please let adults on the same policy use separate profiles instead of sharing one login.
The adviser resolved my question and emailed a concise summary afterward. That follow-through was genuinely helpful.
I spent fifteen minutes navigating the phone menu before reaching billing, only to be transferred back to the claims queue.
The chat displayed 'connection lost' while I waited, but the real setback was being placed at the end of the queue when I rejoined.
The app and website use different names for the same claim milestones. Nothing failed, but switching between them was confusing.
From opening the claim through receiving the payment, the journey was easy to follow, although one confirmation message arrived later than expected.
I would like one activity history that combines form edits, document submissions, claim-stage changes, and payments.
